c.v: The Bit Stream Processing (BSP) module frames data from the Transmit Buffer (e.g., bit stuffing and additional CRC fields) and generating a bit stream for the Bit Timing Logic (BTL) module.
At the same time, the BSP module is also responsible for processing the received bit stream (e.g., de-stuffing and verifying CRC) from the BTL module and placing the message into the Receive FIFO.
The BSP will also detect errors on the
bus and report them to the Error Management Logic (EML).
